subject: Altering parameter values in reruns of micro_ncep() during rerun

messages.author: 15914ff4afa133aa
messages.subject: Altering parameter values in reruns of micro_ncep() during rerun
parts:
Hi Mike,

I am trying to rerun micro_ncep() using saved forcing data (save parameter set to 2) but am running into issues when trying to alter some parameters. I am trying to use a temperature offset using the "warm" parameter and am getting the error:

Error in microclimate(micro) : 
  NA/NaN/Inf in foreign function call (arg 43)

Any thoughts on how to resolve this issue?

Thanks!
-Andrew

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: Altering parameter values in reruns of micro_ncep() during rerun
parts:
Hi Andrew,

There was indeed a bug - the hourly infrared input is made negative if not being used (IR = 0, the default, or IR = 1), but needs to be adjusted if IR = 2 and you're changing the air temp offset via 'warm'. I needed to put a catch in there so that the warming wasn't applied to the hourly infrared unless IR = 2. That's done now on the latest github version and the problem should be resolved. Note that the data is saved without the 'warm' factor being applied, so you can change it when save = 2 and you'll be able to play around with that parameter without having to download all the NCEP data each time.

All the best,
Mike
